description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary and Impact Tremors trigger twice each.
Resolve both Burning-Tree Emissary triggers, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, deals 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu and Impact Tremors trigger twice each.
Resolve both Horned Kavu triggers, returning Horned Kavu and Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, deals 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.
